A [[human]] [[Gender|female]] '''[[Rebel pilot|pilot]]''' served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> she served in [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] at the [[Battle of Atollon]] where she flew a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing]] and made bombing runs on one of [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Star Destroyer]]s. On the second pass, she was killed by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] protecting the Star Destroyer.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Equipment==
This pilot wore an [[Color|orange]] [[flight suit]] and a [[Flight helmet|helmet]] with a [[Color|gold]] visor.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

==Behind the scenes==
This character appeared in "[[Zero Hour]]," in which her voice was provided by [[Mary Elizabeth McGlynn]]. She was identified as "Rebel Pilot #1" in the episode's credits.<ref name="Zero Hour" />
